# mosaic_grid

> A Flutter package of lazy grids whose tiles size themselves: aligned rows that grow to their tallest tile, masonry columns, tiles that span several columns, paging (header, footer, `onEndReached`) and jump-to-item (`MosaicController`). No aspect ratio and no fixed extent to tune, no `IntrinsicHeight`, no dependencies beyond Flutter. Flutter 3.32 or later, all six platforms, vertical or horizontal, right-to-left.

Install with `flutter pub add mosaic_grid` and `import 'package:mosaic_grid/mosaic_grid.dart';`. The pieces:

- `MosaicGrid.builder(itemCount:, itemBuilder:, columns:, layout:, columnGap:, rowGap:)`: the scroll view, with `header`, `footer`, `onEndReached`, `endReachedKey`
- `SliverMosaicGrid.builder(...)`: the same grid as a sliver, for a `CustomScrollView`
- `MosaicColumns.count(n)`, `.minExtent(e, maxCount: m)`, `.maxExtent(e)`: the column count, resolved from the grid's own cross-axis extent, not the screen
- `MosaicLayout.rows(fit: MosaicRowFit.stretch | start | center | end)` (the default) and `MosaicLayout.masonry()`
- `columnSpan: (i) => ...`: columns per item, decided from the data before the tile is built; spans larger than the column count take the whole row
- `MosaicController().jumpToIndex(i)` / `animateToIndex(i, duration:)`: exact even for items never built

Tiles are measured with an unbounded main-axis extent first, so `Expanded` and `Spacer` along the scroll axis do not work inside a tile; use `MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween` to pin content to the bottom of a stretched card.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/mosaic_grid/main/README.md): The tour: layouts, columns, paging, jump-to-item, slivers, full parameter tables, tips, how it works, FAQ
- [Example app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Franklyn-R-Silva/mosaic_grid/main/example/lib/main.dart): The gallery: a paged catalog in aligned rows, a masonry board, a playground with every option
- [Live demo](https://franklyn-r-silva.github.io/mosaic_grid/): The example app running in the browser
